allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
feat(scan): add firmware detection and automatic chip temperature via Braiins API

- Add Firmware column to scan output showing Braiins OS version
- Auto-detect Braiins OS miners by querying GraphQL API
- Fetch chip temperatures from Braiins API (supports both "chip" and "MAX_CHIP" fields)
- Remove --scan-temps flag requirement (temps now shown by default)
- Remove Port column from scan output for cleaner display
- Falls back to "Stock" firmware for non-Braiins miners
- Supports Braiins OS versions 25.01 and 25.07

Temperature detection prioritizes Braiins GraphQL API for Braiins miners,
with fallback to devs/stats commands for stock firmware miners.
EOF
)")
